job.title: Technical Lead Magento 2 (m/w/d), Full Stack E-Commerce

tailoring.headline: Technical Lead E-Commerce | SAP Commerce Cloud & Full-Stack Java Developer
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering large-scale SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, REST/OCC APIs, microservices, and end-to-end PIM/ERP/MDM integrations. Proven record of leading junior developers, driving CI/CD pipelines, Docker/Kubernetes deployments, and bridging business and IT through techno-functional analysis and agile delivery. Certified SAP Commerce Cloud professional with strong AI-assisted development skills.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Technical Lead Magento 2 (m/w/d), Full Stack E-Commerce
cover_en.hook: I am excited about RidersDeal’s mission to revolutionize e-mobility commerce and see a perfect fit for my background. With over five years of hands-on experience building and scaling SAP Commerce Cloud platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep e-commerce, integration and leadership expertise that aligns with the Technical Lead role.

bullets.label: E-Commerce Expertise
bullets.text: Designed and delivered end-to-end SAP Commerce Cloud solutions, handling product catalogs, pricing and order management for global B2B/B2C customers.

bullets.label: API Integration
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST web services and built robust PIM-to-ERP data pipelines, ensuring seamless data flow across systems.

bullets.label: Leadership & Guidance
bullets.text: Provided technical guidance to junior developers, led code reviews and drove CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2, enhancing release reliability.

bullets.label: Agile & DevOps
bullets.text: Operated in Scrum teams, championed agile PI planning and automated deployments using Docker, Kubernetes and Jenkins.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, Germany, I hold a valid German residence and work permit, am serving notice until 15 December 2026 and can start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to RidersDeal.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Technical Lead Magento 2 (m/w/d), Full Stack E-Commerce
cover_de.hook: Die Vision von RidersDeal, die E-Mobility-Marktlandschaft zu verändern, begeistert mich. Mit über fünf Jahren Erfahrung im Aufbau und Betrieb von SAP Commerce Cloud Plattformen bei Rockwell Automation und Shell bringe ich fundiertes E-Commerce- und Integrationswissen mit, das exakt zu der Position des Technical Lead passt.

bullets.label: E-Commerce-Kompetenz
bullets.text: Konzipierte und implementierte umfassende SAP Commerce Cloud-Lösungen für globale B2B- und B2C-Kunden, inkl. Produktkatalog, Preisgestaltung und Auftragsmanagement.

bullets.label: API-Integration
bullets.text: Entwickelte OCC-REST-Web-Services und etablierte robuste PIM-zu-ERP-Datenpipelines für nahtlose System-Synchronisation.

bullets.label: Führung & Anleitung
bullets.text: Leitete technische Guidance für Junior-Entwickler, führte Code-Reviews durch und steuerte CI/CD-Deployments auf CCv2, wodurch die Release-Qualität gesteigert wurde.

bullets.label: Agile & DevOps
bullets.text: Arbeitete in Scrum-Teams, verantwortete PI-Planning und automatisierte Deployments mit Docker, Kubernetes und Jenkins.

cover_de.logistics: Ich wohne in Karlsruhe, verfüge über eine gültige deutsche Aufenthaltserlaubnis, befinde mich in der Kündigungsfrist bis zum 15.12.2026 und kann ab dem 16.12.2026 starten. Ich freue mich auf ein Gespräch, um meinen Beitrag zu RidersDeal zu erläutern.

tailoring.why_company: RidersDeal stands out as a fast-growing platform that combines e-mobility with a seamless online marketplace. Your focus on innovative, customer-centric solutions aligns with my passion for building scalable e-commerce systems. I am eager to apply my SAP Commerce expertise to help RidersDeal expand its digital footprint, optimize integrations and deliver a superior shopping experience for riders across Europe.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to drive RidersDeal’s e-commerce growth by leveraging my SAP Commerce, API integration and full-stack leadership experience.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce developer with 5+ years of e-commerce leadership. I’m very interested in the Technical Lead role at RidersDeal and would love to discuss how I can add value. Let’s connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Technical Lead Magento 2 (m/w/d) – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Technical Lead Magento 2 position at RidersDeal. I bring over five years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience, strong API integration skills and proven leadership in agile environments. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my fit for the role.

Best regards
